description: stacked preprocessing pipeline (numeric -> title_table -> markup_opcode) + cmix back-end (subprocess)
notes: Maximum-stacking pure-preprocessor variant. NOT the cmix-sidecar architecture (that requires C++ mixer modification). Layer escape bytes are mutually disjoint (0x11 / 0x10 / 0x00). Layer interaction: title_table consumes some patterns markup_opcode would catch — net effect is empirical. Score-honesty caveat: cmix binary not inlined.
